Follows sitemap index to discover child sitemaps

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import map_urls, create_engine

async def main() -> None:
    engine = create_engine(None)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await map_urls(engine, url)
    print(len(result.urls))

asyncio.run(main())
```
